1.explanation:
1. FluidTimePicker.js – this is the component responsible for rendering the fluid input, divider and the error/warning icon. Currently it applies container classes for invalid/warning, but it never passes the invalid or warn flags down into the FluidTextInput itself, so the red/grey border and padding styles never get applied. This file should be updated to forward these props (and corresponding CSS classes) into the inner text input and adjust any margin or padding around the icon to match the 8px/16px spec.  
2. FluidTimePicker-test.js – the unit tests here only cover the default and fluid classes. Once the component is updated to support warning state (and passes invalid/warn through to the input), tests must be extended or updated to assert that the new warning classes appear, and that the error state still renders the correct class and icon as expected.
1.bug_scenario: The bug shows that when you render the experimental FluidTimePicker with invalid (error) or warn (warning) props, the inner text‐input does not get the correct red/grey border treatment or the proper spacing around the error/warning icon. The red outline, icon background and the horizontal spacing (8px between the input edge and icon and 16px between icon and select) do not match the design spec, and the warning state styling is missing entirely.
